C0657.title: Trojan Implanted in E-Commerce Cloud Warehouses to Steal Express Parcel Label Data
C0657.summary: Starting November 2021, a criminal group implanted trojan software in over 100 e-commerce cloud warehouses across Zhejiang, Guangdong, Sichuan, and other regions, illegally stealing over 5 million express parcel label records. The data was sold through intermediaries or directly to fraud groups, with the total amount involved reaching approximately 30 million yuan. The case was cracked by the Yuya
